verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs publishes a per-hour API price for Scribe v2 ($0.22 per hour), so an agent can estimate a base transcription cost from audio duration before submitting. The evidence does not show itemized prices for add-ons such as keyterm prompting, entity detection, redaction, multichannel or realtime, so a full pre-submission cost calculation is not established. Missing for 10: itemized add-on pricing, realtime versus batch rate distinction, machine-readable pricing access, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can compute the cost of a transcription job before submitting it, because pricing is published per audio minute or hour with add-on prices itemized
